definitions.explanation: Work done in a garden or yard, such as weeding, planting, pruning, mowing, and general maintenance.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{庭仕事|にわしごと}をする。
examples.english: I do garden work on weekends.

examples.japanese: {暖|あたた}かくなると{庭仕事|にわしごと}が{忙|いそが}しくなる。
examples.english: When it gets warm, garden work gets busy.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{退職|たいしょく}してから{庭仕事|にわしごと}を{日課|にっか}にしている。
examples.english: Since retiring, my grandfather has made garden work part of his daily routine.

notes:
Composed of {庭|にわ} (garden/yard) + {仕事|しごと} (work). A straightforward compound referring to all types of work done in a garden.

USAGE:
{庭仕事|にわしごと} covers a broad range of activities including {草|くさ}むしり (weeding), {剪定|せんてい} (pruning), {水|みず}やり (watering), {植|う}え{替|か}え (replanting), and {芝刈|しばか}り (mowing).
The ～{仕事|しごと} pattern is productive in Japanese for forming compound nouns: {力仕事|ちからしごと} (physical labor), {家事|かじ}{仕事|しごと} (housework), {針仕事|はりしごと} (needlework).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}をする: to do garden work
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}に{精|せい}を{出|だ}す: to devote oneself to gardening
- {庭仕事|にわしごと}{用|よう}の{手袋|てぶくろ}: gardening gloves

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ガーデニング: gardening — the loanword, often implies more ornamental or hobby-oriented gardening
- {園芸|えんげい}: horticulture, gardening — a broader term that can include indoor plants and professional cultivation
- {草|くさ}むしり: weeding — one specific type of {庭仕事|にわしごと}
